n18336.source: tr. Herbert Weir Smyth, New York 1922 (Perseus)
lines: May Zeus who guards suppliants look graciously upon our company, which boarded a ship and put to sea from the outlets of the fine sand of the Nile. For we have fled Zeus’ land
